data.title: Pete Hegseth to visit Israel, meet with Benjamin Netanyahu, Katz, after Iran strikes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Hegseth, who is in Ankara alongside US President Donald Trump for the NATO summit, is expected to make a brief visit against the backdrop of the American strikes against Iran.
